plainText:
Goh's Golurk (Japanese: ゴウのゴルーグ Go's Goloog) is the third that Goh in the Unova region, and his twenty-seventh overall. It is a giant Pokémon.

==In animation==
===History===
==== ====
 
Golurk debuted in Raid Battle in The Ruins!, where Goh and visited the Unova region to explore the Colossus Ruins in the Desert Resort. After hatching from an ancient egg, it engaged in a Raid Battle with Ash, Goh, , and the excavation . After a hard-fought battle, Goh eventually managed to it. Afterward, it was seen in the Cerise Laboratory, interacting with Goh's other .

In Panic in the Park!, while trying to stop a fight that broke out between the other Pokémon during a food shortage, the seal on Golurk's chest was knocked off, causing it to go berserk. Ash and Goh kept Golurk distracted while , , , and put the seal back on. It then helped protect the from the flood caused by its rampage, allowing them to evolve into .

In Restore and Renew!, Goh used Golurk to help him dig up Fossils at the Pewter Museum of Science. Later, when an revived from an Old Amber Goh had found went out of control, Goh sent out Golurk to battle it after had been defeated. Golurk was eventually able to stop Aerodactyl's rampage, after which Goh was able to convince to let him catch it.

In Heroes Unite!, Golurk joined the rest of Goh's Pokémon at the lab to celebrate their Trainer's return from the last mission of Project Mew. In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, it attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. After that, it posed for a group photo with Goh, Ash, and the others.
 

===Personality and characteristics===
 
Golurk is a giant Pokémon, being much larger than other Golurk. It is very powerful; during the Raid Battle in Raid Battle in The Ruins!, it managed to take down all of the opposing Pokémon and land hits on Goh's Darmanitan and Ash's Dragonite. In battle, Golurk forgoes precise attacks, preferring to use its long-range attacks like in sweeping arcs. Under Goh's control, it was able to use its size and power to withstand several hits from a , biding its time until it could land a punishing blow with .

Despite its considerable size and strength, it is a gentle giant outside of battle, as seen during its interactions with some of Goh's other Pokémon at the Cerise Laboratory, and doesn't seem to mind the other Pokémon resting on it while it is relaxing. In Restore and Renew!, Golurk was shown to be mindful of its own strength, heaving a large boulder out of the way for Goh and the others before gently fitting a much smaller stone between its fingertips to examine it for fossils. If the seal on its chest is removed, its energy runs wild, with the energy's color turning from yellow to red as it rampages. While on a rampage, it can cause significant damage to its surroundings, and cause torrential rainfall, just like the move .

It also shows a desire to protect Pokémon, as shown when it protected Goh's three that were about to get hit with an attack from Darmanitan.

===Moves used===
 
 
 
 

==In the games==
===Pokémon Ga-Olé===
Golurk appears in Pokémon Ga-Olé as one of Goh's Pokémon. It is an opponent during the .

====As an opponent====
 

 

===Pokémon GO===
On November 6, 2020, as part of Pokémon GO's Animation Week 2020 event, which was based on , several Pokémon based on those that Ash and Goh encountered in the animated series appeared more frequently in the wild, in s, from 7 km Eggs, and during surprise encounters, with Golurk appearing only in level 3 raids. The event ran from November 6, 2020, at 8:00 a.m., to November 12, 2020, at 10:00 p.m. local time.

==Trivia==
Golurk is the first giant Pokémon owned by a .
Golurk is the first gender unknown Pokémon owned by Goh.
